cohort: 172 newborns up to 4 days old diagnosed with neonatal sepsis in Karaganda, Kazakhstan
finding: Neonatal sepsis mortality (22%) was associated with low birth weight, gestational age, and comorbidities, but not with maternal COVID-19 status.
mod_finding: This study on neonatal sepsis during COVID-19 examined mode of delivery as a factor but did not report specific findings related to it in the abstract.
